name: automatebrowser
description: Drive your real, logged-in Chrome or Edge tab from Claude. Needs the AutomateBrowser browser extension.
long_description: AutomateBrowser lets Claude click, type, read and screenshot pages in the browser you already use, with your logins intact. This bundle is the server half only: install the AutomateBrowser extension in Chrome or Edge as well, or every tool answers that no browser is connected. Setup: https://farazpawle.github.io/automatebrowser/
